correctness.rationale: Exact symbolic checks recreate the published triadic fitnesses, Fourier decomposition and strict nonvanishing bound |K|>|L|, Jacobian trace, vertex invasion eigenvalues and two thresholds. The unique interior sink and attracting hyperbolic heteroclinic boundary have disjoint open basins; their nonempty invariant relative basin boundary lies in a compact equilibrium-free interior region, so Poincare-Bendixson yields a periodic orbit. The proof does not rely on numerical orbit plots.
